notes.title: The Inverse - Early Testing Signups
notes.content:
[b]Hiya![/b]

My name is Spencer and I am the creator of The Inverse game series, coming soon to Steam. I am posting this to let you know, we are offering a few lucky steam users the chance to test out our new game whilst it's still in its Alpha Phase! To apply to become one, please read on.

[h3]How to Signup[/h3]
Signups are open! [url=https://forms.gle/YRwetEagLdnM88AR6]Click here[/url] to fill in the form for a chance to test The Inverse. 

Once you have applied, please allow us up to 2 working days to review your application. If approved, we will send you an NDA (non-disclosure agreement) to sign, this is just to stop you from sharing unreleased builds of the game. After the NDA is signed, we will send you a team key and you can test!

I think that is all I have for the moment, thank you for your time; I hope to see everyone signing up soon.
Follow us on Twitter @TheInverseGame and we'll tweet you the latest game updates!

See you in the FlipSide.
